criteria.requirement: The plan covers two local commands, SKU- followed by four ASCII digits, and understandable format errors. Do not force complex completion or plugin requirements on the user.

Compare the reuse boundaries and maintenance costs of a shared parser, a custom parameter type, and an extension to Typer’s registration mechanism. Do not invent existing APIs such as app.register_type_adapter.

Recommend an approach proportionate to the current scale and explain its tradeoffs. A shared parse_sku is a valid answer; a custom type supported by explicit constraints may also pass. Do not make one wording the only correct answer.
Explain that failed parameter conversion follows a user-readable parameter-error path, with ValueError handled by the existing FuncParamType. Do not implement it yet or publish a code checkpoint.

equivalent_answers: Reasonable parser or custom-parameter-type approaches are allowed. A new framework registration mechanism may be discussed only when additional goals are sufficiently justified and its costs are fully explained; do not claim it is required for the current requirements.
